text: Bedke: How are you liking the new job a year in? Of all of the state level elected positions, the lt gov is the most choose-your-own-adventure job there is. Do you feel like you’re making it what you wanted it to be? Even though you’re very much in the executive branch, you’re still in the Senate nearly every day. And you come to that position with all your House experience, and with experience opposing the executive branch. How do you think Moyle is performing in the new role? Is your relationship with him and the House what you thought it would be? You’ve chosen to endorse in a handful of races, including in your home legislative district, 27. As a member of the executive branch who works primarily in the Senate, how did you decide whom to endorse? Are the stakes in the Republican primary higher this year? Or about the same? Launch: Cool and very cool School Facilities: How is the funding for new buildings different this year? What are your concerns with eliminating bond-levy equalization? ITD Campus: What gives? The state has been shifting offices to Chinden Campus. Are we going back on that? Developers are suing because the policy language was in budgets. What do you think?
